user.title: Battery and tariff
user.description: The integration starts in simulation mode. Grid charging is disabled unless you explicitly enable it.

prices.title: Prices and forecasts
prices.description: Select the price timeline, price history, battery SoC and remaining PV forecast sensors.

power.title: Live power
power.description: Select power sensors in watts. Load phase sensors are added into gross whole-site consumption. If EV planning is enabled, they must include the wallbox and must not be grid-import sensors.

energy.title: Long-term energy counters
energy.description: Select monotonically increasing total-energy sensors in kWh. They are used to learn the non-shiftable base load.

optional.title: Optional inputs and advanced control
optional.description: Weather improves diagnostics. A control helper and Victron Modbus host are optional; leave both empty for observation-only use.

ev.title: Electric vehicle planning
ev.description: Optional. This beta calculates a charging schedule but never controls the wallbox.

ev_details.title: Electric vehicle inputs
ev_details.description: The gross load sensors selected earlier must include house and wallbox consumption; they are not grid-import sensors. This beta only observes. Normal charging defaults to 3.6 kW and automatic recommendations never exceed 11 kW.
